title: MOR Setting
description: ⚙️针对于MOR界面汉化而自由开放的资源包，请核对对应MOR版本下载
body:
## ❗该资源包对口国人！且需与对应版本的[[MOR]Major overhaul and reorganization](https://modrinth.com/modpack/mor)配套使用！否则，它将不启用任何效果！English translation at the end
## ✨作用：
🔸正如摘要说所，该资源包旨在对MOR整合包进行汉化，为了方便以后的管理和更新_~~（因为我不想在每一次更新汉化补丁的时候都要重新打包一次整合包，所以特意将这个资源包单独列出）~~_
## ⚙️使用：
🔹这是一个资源包，在您下载了对应的整合包版本的文件后，直接拖入加载即可，具体改变在配置界面，可以看见

🔹再次提醒！在下载资源包的时候请注意对应的整合包版本！如若不适用将会出现报错或延长加载时间、降低性能等问题
## ❌错误报告：
🔺请前往此[中文WIKI](https://www.bilibili.com/opus/1099896667345256472/?from=readlist)界面提交报错，或需求新版本的汉化更新，谢谢
# 🚩Here is the English translation
## ❗This resource pack is tailored for Chinese users and must be used with the corresponding version of [[MOR]Major overhaul and reorganization](https://modrinth.com/modpack/mor) modpack! Otherwise, it will not activate any effects!
## ✨Purpose:
🔸 As the summary states, this resource pack aims to localize the MOR modpack into Chinese. It’s separated for easier management and future updates —~~(because I don’t want to repackage the entire modpack every time I update the localization patch)~~.
## ⚙️Usage:
🔹 This is a resource pack. After downloading the correct version of the modpack files, simply drag and drop this pack into your resource pack folder and enable it. The changes will be visible in the configuration interface.
🔹 Reminder! Please make sure the resource pack version matches your modpack version. Mismatched versions may cause errors, longer loading times, or performance issues.
## ❌Bug Reports:
🔺 Please submit bug reports or request new localization updates here on the [Chinese Wiki](https://www.bilibili.com/opus/1099896667345256472/?from=readlist). Thank you!
